name: Fastmail
summary: Private, ad-free email hosting with your own domain. Fast, secure email, calendars and contacts from an independent provider that doesn't mine your data. From 1 August 2026 you pick EU (Amsterdam) or US data residency, encrypted at rest on Fastmail's own servers — note that EU data is initially still replicated and backed up to the US while that infrastructure matures.
best_for: individuals and small businesses that want fast, private, ad-free email on their own domain with proper support and masked-email aliases
skip_if: your team lives in Google Docs/Drive collaboration (Workspace bundles that), or free mail genuinely serves you and privacy isn't a priority
honest_knock: You're paying for what the free giants monetize differently: no ads, no profiling, real support and standards-first email (JMAP/IMAP everywhere). The honest limits: it's email/calendar/contacts, not a Workspace-style office suite, so document collaboration lives elsewhere, and migrating decades of Gmail habits (filters, integrations) takes a weekend of care. For owning your address on your own domain, it's the boring, excellent choice.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-08-26 on fastmail.com/pricing over a US connection, with their country selector on United States and the 12-month term chosen; re-read 2026-09-29 from a Dutch connection, and again on 2026-10-15 on both fastmail.com/pricing/us/ and /pricing/nl/: the same numerals in dollars and euros on an unchanged 1-, 12-, 24- and 36-month ladder, with the US prices shown tax-exclusive and the euro prices tax-inclusive) Individual is $5 a month, or $60 for twelve months, with 60 GB of storage for one person. Duo is $8 a month ($96 a year) for two inboxes and 120 GB. Family is $11 a month ($132 a year) for up to six people and up to 360 GB, at 60 GB each. The page also sells 24- and 36-month terms, so the twelve-month figure is the middle of three commitments rather than the cheapest one.

exit_test.what: Two fictional address-book contacts, with multiline notes, PNG photos and groups, exported and reimported during the trial.
exit_test.awkward: The contact form offers no custom fields, general record date or amount field. Birthday is a different field. A second user triggers mobile verification; the same message also requires verification before a first outgoing message. An upgrade ends the remaining trial and starts the subscription immediately, with no refund for unused time.

friction.export_route: Settings > Migration > Export > Download all contacts.
friction.format: vCard 3.0 with embedded base64 PNG photos; two cards before and four after reimport.
friction.reimport: Import > Upload contacts and calendars > Contacts reported success, but retained UIDs did not update existing contacts: four contacts remained.
friction.cancellation: Actual cancellation, trial expiry and account deletion were not tested.

not_tested: Complete signup screen count and human first-result setup time.
Actual cancellation, expiry, deletion and follow-up mail.
Kit fields that were not entered.
came_along: Both names, emails, nicknames and notes survive vCard export, including accents, quotes and line breaks. Embedded photo bytes match the two kit PNGs.
lost: Download all contacts omits group membership: neither of the two assigned groups per contact is exported.
Reimporting the modified vCard creates two duplicates with new UIDs. The original second contact retains its old note; an additional copy carries the updated note.
exit_test.note: One export and re-import of synthetic records, on the account and date stated. Friction is described, not scored; this is not a verdict on the product.

sessions.what: Tested by our team on 30 October 2026 on the free trial: Daan created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in Daan's browser. We added two made-up contacts with a photo each, exported the address book, changed one note in the export and imported it again.
findings: The trial showed 30 days, with no card. Upgrading ends the trial straight away: the checkout says the subscription starts today and that there are no refunds for unused time.
Individual was €6 a month on the monthly term, €1.04 of it VAT, or €5 a month on a 12-month term.
Adding a second user, and by the same message sending your first email, first asks you to verify a mobile phone number by text.
The contact form has names, company, nickname, birthday, email, phone, address and notes, but no custom fields.
The vCard export brought back names with accents, multi-line notes and the photos byte for byte. The groups we used as tags were missing from it.
Importing the edited vCard did not update anything: it added two new contacts with new IDs, so we ended up with four.
not_tested: Connecting another mailbox or a custom domain
sessions.note: Findings as written up after the session; no pass/fail per task was scored.
